csv_project_name: Engineering for LCTA Bus Stop Improvement Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The goal of this project is to engineer improved bus stop accessibility at existing bus stops across the LCTA system, while ensuring compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and the Public Right of Way Accessibility Guidelines (PROWAG). The project only includes design work for concrete improvements at existing bus stops and permitting, along with completing the Section 106 and Categorical Exclusion worksheet to support the Federally funded project.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Planning/Master Planning, Transportation Planning

title: Engineering for LCTA Bus Stop Improvement Plan
short_description: Design services for ADA-compliant accessibility improvements at existing bus stops.
project_scope: Engineering and permitting for accessibility improvements at existing bus stops across the Luzerne County Transportation Authority system. The scope is limited to design work for concrete improvements at existing stops, with ADA and PROWAG compliance, plus Section 106 documentation and a Categorical Exclusion worksheet for a federally funded project.
services: Civil engineering design for rehabilitation/refurbishment of existing bus stops, permitting, surveying/GIS/mapping, planning/transportation planning, and preparation of Section 106 and Categorical Exclusion documentation.
relevance_explanation:
- Project concerns existing bus stop accessibility upgrades, not bridges, buildings, roofs, towers, or special structures.
- Scope is rehabilitation/refurbishment of small transportation infrastructure rather than structurally demanding new construction.
- Likely limited to concrete flatwork and accessibility compliance.
- Includes planning, permitting, and environmental documentation, which are not core sbp target services.
- Clearly outside sbp's priority sectors and structural complexity profile.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source.
